caption.text: Like for real, what would you do??? 🇨🇴🤷‍♂️💳 #joefelz #travellife

This is your your daily reminder to chase your dreams.

I was getting it shirtless & barefoot up this mountain in Cali when 4 young Colombianos pointed & yelled. At first I thought it might have been a hold up, but I quickly realized they recognized me off of socials & I met 4 friends in a foreign country I didn’t know I had.

For a throwaway, 8x felon whose family betrayed him & society  cast out, getting spotted in a foreign country then stopping for a photo op was pretty damn cool. 

So, yeah, chase your dreams. There’s a big old world out there and nothing epic ever happens in your front yard 🇨🇴🤝⛰️ #joefelz #chaseyourdreams #spotted #colombia #newfriends
